label.text: Start syncing brings your mail in, the newest first: it shows in the Inbox as it arrives, and keeps in step with the server from then on. What you do here (read, move, delete, send) happens on the server too, as in any mail app.

Start syncing turns the account on. The mail gateway delivers the mail, and there is no mail server to sync. A tag after a plus sign still arrives here: sales+news@example.com goes to sales@example.com.
